comments:
Accessima is a UK accessibility consultancy doing manual WCAG audits. We built this checker because clients kept asking why a colour passed on body text but failed elsewhere, so it shows the AA and AAA thresholds for normal and large text together rather than a single pass or fail. Free, no account needed. Happy to reword anything to fit the list's format.
Adam Senior, hello@accessima.com
features: A free online colour contrast checker. Enter a foreground and background colour (hex or colour picker) to see the contrast ratio and a pass or fail against WCAG 2.2 AA and AAA for normal and large text, with a live preview. Includes swap, presets and a shareable link to each result. No sign-up needed.
title: Accessima Colour Contrast Checker
